title: Route-independent minimal owner cut-set for PAH-OMC-020
question: Do the existing PAH-OMC-020 records reduce every admissible route to a common minimal cut-set of source semantics, comparison/target identification, and full-domain temporal control, without adding a new model or repeating a finite diagnostic?
purpose: Freeze a single re-entry test after the fixed-n, radial, path-word, target-identification, source-wellposedness and anchored-n persistence checkpoints. This is a dependency theorem about the registered proof routes, not a replacement for the missing owner packet.

S0_source_semantics.meaning: The exact finite object is selected: root labels, multiplicities, duplicate/invalid moves, root counting measure, finite generator and stationary normalization are fixed by source authority or an explicitly named successor.
S0_source_semantics.evidence: R-559 shows immutable PAH-001 is not uniquely selected by current bytes; R-560 reports no owner-authorized successor packet.

S1_comparison_target.meaning: At least one complete comparison route is supplied for the unchanged model: form route with common realization, N1, liminf/recovery, boundary control, exact R-512 target and correlation transfer, or path route with common path law, tightness, generator/form equality, uniqueness and correlation transfer.
S1_comparison_target.evidence: R-536 marks both form and path route field sets incomplete; R-557 lists the corresponding owner fields.

S2_temporal_control.meaning: The declared j-before-anchored-n compact-time quantifiers are controlled on the full local-cylinder domain: fixed-n J plus anchored D, or an equivalent source-authorized conditional path/N4 estimate that yields the same error budget.
S2_temporal_control.evidence: R-534 leaves J/K/D inputs conditional; R-542 blocks promotion from stationary averages to stopping-time control; R-564 blocks promotion of a finite derivative gap to an anchored-n result.

route_rule.admissible: S0_source_semantics AND S1_comparison_target AND S2_temporal_control, with one complete S1 alternative and all original j-before-n quantifiers.
route_rule.mainline_advance: Only an owner-authorized, hash-pinned packet instantiating all three cuts may advance PAH-OMC-020.
route_rule.hold_for_evidence: Any missing cut keeps the actual route HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE; absence is not a universal no-go for a future owner-fixed successor.
route_rule.negative_result: Reserved for an exact unchanged-source contradiction to one required cut, not for a missing packet or a researcher-owned conditional theorem.

replay_obligations: Verify every parent SHA-256 and the unchanged PAH-OMC-020 order.
Check that R-559 is source-level only and R-564 is a logical non-implication, so neither is over-promoted.
Evaluate FORM_ROUTE and PATH_ROUTE as disjoint Boolean alternatives; reject partial packets and radial-only evidence.
Show that S0, S1 and S2 are all required by the current route contracts, while no new finite calculation is used.
Compile the finite Boolean cut-set theorem in Lean and run independent and hostile mutation checks.
single_next_question: Can one source-authorized, hash-pinned packet instantiate S0 plus either complete comparison route and the full-domain temporal control S2 without changing PAH-001 or its j-before-anchored-n order?
non_claims: This contract does not prove PAH-OMC-020 convergence or refute every owner-fixed successor.
It does not construct a common Hilbert space, path law, compensator, generator, carrier, rate, state, regulator or limit.
It does not promote R-559 source-level nonuniqueness or R-564 abstract persistence to an anchored-n universal no-go.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion; external Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping.
